messages.cli.run.option.desktop_bell: Allow desktop notifications without a terminal when kingdom.bell.desktop is true.
messages.cli.run.locked: Another Steward is already running in {kingdom}: one kingdom has one Steward.
messages.cli.run.notice.awaiting_seal: Quest {quest} «{title}» passed review and waits for your seal.
messages.cli.run.notice.environment: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review: its check {check} failed because of its environment, not the work ({line}). No judge reads it and nobody loses a level; the checks run again in {minutes} minutes. Log: {log}
messages.cli.run.notice.mana_asleep: Out of mana: {gauge}. What runs on it pauses and keeps its character; the Steward probes until the mana is back.
messages.cli.run.notice.mana_asleep_until: Out of mana: {gauge}, until {resets_at}. What runs on it pauses and keeps its character; the Steward probes just after the reset.
messages.cli.run.notice.mana_awake: Mana is back: {gauge}. Its paused quests go on.
messages.cli.run.notice.mana_warning: Mana running low: {gauge} has used {used_pct}% of its {window} window. Near the cap the world stops taking work there; elvaria character model moves a character to another model.
messages.cli.run.build_source: Running from the source at {root}, not from a pinned build.
messages.cli.run.notice.question: Quest {quest} «{title}» asks you: {question} To answer: elvaria answer {quest} "…"
messages.cli.run.notice.subquests_refused: Plan {quest} «{title}» is delivered but opened no sub-quest: {reason}. See: elvaria quest show {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.delivery_pushed: Quest {quest} «{title}»: branch pushed, pull request open: {url}
messages.cli.run.notice.delivery_pushed_warnings: Quest {quest} «{title}»: branch pushed, pull request open: {url}. Added lines match a shared secret pattern in {files}: look at them before you merge.
messages.cli.run.notice.delivery_failed: Quest {quest} «{title}»: the delivery stopped at {stage}: {why} Deliver again: elvaria quest deliver {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.delivery_merge_quest: Quest {quest} «{title}»: the delivery stopped at {stage}; the merge quest {merge} resolves it, for your seal.
messages.cli.run.notice.base_red: Territory {territory}: the default branch turned red at {checks}. See: elvaria digest
messages.cli.run.notice.delegation_suspended: The delegation of the seal on {territory} is suspended: {cause} (quest {quest}). New quests there wait for the seal; read what escaped, then: elvaria territory delegation {territory} --resume
messages.cli.run.notice.base_red_draft: Territory {territory}: the default branch turned red at {checks}. Draft quest {quest} waits for you: elvaria quest confirm {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.merge_conflict: {role} {quest} «{title}»: merging {branch} stopped on a conflict in {files}. The merge waits in its plot; a knight concludes it in the quest's next run.
messages.cli.run.notice.merge_refused: {role} {quest} «{title}»: git or a hook refused to merge {branch}. A knight takes the next run; the log of elvaria run says why. See: elvaria quest show {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.merge_missing: {role} {quest} «{title}»: there is no branch {branch} to merge. See: elvaria quest show {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.suspended: {character} failed the same way ({fail_kind}) {count} times in a row and went to the Temple.
messages.cli.run.notice.temple: Temple: {character}'s report added {added} line(s) of scripture, took {retired} out and had {refused} refused; it filed {letters} letter(s). Read them with elvaria scripture list and elvaria memo list.
messages.cli.run.notice.temple_rejected: Temple: {character}'s report was refused whole and nothing was written: its {refused} operation(s) would replace a scripture (more than 3 new lines, or more than half of the Monk's lines of one file).
messages.cli.run.notice.temple_released: Released: {characters}, fail streak back at 0 (a new line cures its failure).
messages.cli.run.notice.unclaimable: Quest {quest} «{title}», rank {rank}, waits. {reason} See: elvaria quest show {quest}
messages.cli.run.notice.judge_mana: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review, but every {classes} who may judge it is out of mana: {gauges}. The review opens once a pool opens again; not to wait, summon a judge of another model on another pool: elvaria character add <id> --class {class} --tribe <tribe>
messages.cli.run.notice.digest: Digest {day}: {must} to decide for the work to go on, {can_wait} that can wait. Read it in {file}.
messages.cli.run.notice.tribe_held: Tribe {tribe} is held: its CLI {path} now says {version}, not {checked}, the version its last check with the real CLI passed on. No new session for it until elvaria tribe check {tribe} passes (a little mana).
messages.cli.run.notice.tribe_gone: Tribe {tribe} is held: the CLI the Steward starts for it, {path}, is gone. elvaria tribe check {tribe} finds the one now installed and pins it once it passes (a little mana); then restart elvaria run.
messages.cli.run.notice.unjudgeable: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review, but no {classes} of the kingdom may judge it: the judge must not have worked on it and must run another model than {model}. Summon one: elvaria character add <id> --class {class} --model <model>
messages.cli.run.notice.unjudgeable_vision: Quest {quest} «{title}» waits in review for a judge who reads images, but no {classes} of the kingdom may judge it: the judge must be of a tribe whose CLI reads images (its adapter declares vision), must not have worked on it and must run another model than {model}. Summon one: elvaria character add <id> --class {class} --tribe <tribe>
messages.cli.run.notice.wrap_up_assignee: Quest {quest} «{title}»: assignee {character}'s session is past the reminder mark, {used} of a ceiling of {limit} {unit}. It was told to wrap up. If you do nothing it is cut at {cut} {unit}; if it made progress a fresh session goes on, without this one's memory. {raise}
messages.cli.run.notice.wrap_up_verifier: Quest {quest} «{title}»: judge {character}'s session is past the reminder mark, {used} of a ceiling of {limit} {unit}. A judge gets no reminder. If you do nothing it is cut at {cut} {unit} and the review starts over with another judge. {raise}
messages.cli.run.notice.wrap_up_raise_tokens: To give it more: elvaria quest edit {quest} --max-tokens <n>, with n from {from} up; anything lower changes nothing.
messages.cli.run.notice.wrap_up_raise_minutes: To give it more: elvaria quest edit {quest} --max-minutes <n>, with n from {from} up.
messages.cli.run.notice.wrap_up_no_knob: Turns have no knob per quest: this bell only tells you.
messages.cli.run.started: The Steward is running in {kingdom}, one tick every {seconds} s. Ctrl+C stops it.
messages.cli.run.stopping: Stopping the Steward: the sessions it runs end, and their quests are taken up again at the next start.
messages.cli.run.summary: Run the Steward: it gives quests to characters and has their work judged, until you stop it (Ctrl+C).
messages.cli.run.tribe_idle: Tribe {tribe}: adapter {adapter} has no runner yet, so this tribe takes no quest.
messages.cli.run.tribe_broken: Tribe {tribe}: adapter file {adapter} does not load, so this tribe takes no quest:
